title: Beauty for Ashes
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler who sits down in the wreckage before anyone rebuilds, and tonight Isaiah is sent to bind up broken hearts and comfort all who mourn.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because comfort is her gift and her calling. In Willow's world today: Willow's block tower falls and her little brother sits down in the wreckage and cries. Willow does not rebuild it yet. She sits down in the pile beside him and pats his knee until his breathing slows. Just like Isaiah, sent to comfort everyone who mourned, Willow learned that sitting close is the first gift a sad heart needs.
